project.name: LumiField website
project.productType: immersive open-source music player landing page

typography.ui: Inter, Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei UI, system-ui

shadows.immersive: deep black ambient shadows with restrained cyan glow

must: Preserve the LumiField dark cyan-violet identity
Keep the first screen interactive within 2 seconds
Run only one visual effect at a time and dispose the previous instance
Support keyboard, mobile, reduced motion, and visible focus
Keep v1.1.43 release metadata frozen until v1.1.44 is actually published
Display both sponsor QR codes directly in the page
Use source-locked visual algorithms and publish provenance
avoid: External CDN or runtime network dependencies

decisions: Used the existing site primitives and identity instead of introducing a framework.
Mapped user labels to the official React Bits Galaxy, Aurora, Particles, Iridescence, ColorBends, and DotField sources.
Replaced framework render wrappers only; preserved upstream effect math and recorded exact commit hashes.
Made the visual module a dynamic import initialized near the viewport.
evidence: 21st search query: immersive interactive music app visual effect switcher aurora particle shader
